provenance.prompt: Purpose: project-authored free-standing floor mirrors with four real mirror contours, complete wall-mirror frame assemblies and connected physical floor supports. Specification: fixed total envelope .80m x 1.80m x .60m, bottom-centred origin, metres, +Y up and +Z forward. Installation: floor-surface in room/area, identity instance scale, fixed blocking footprint .80m x .60m and empty state/use points. Mirror contract: planar-mirror-v1 / single-512-v1 with face at [0,.92,.026], actual mirror-surface/back/base/post nodes, one coplanar face mesh and one runtime reflection target. Geometry: import the exact original wall GLB, bake +.92m into each Y vertex in Float32, retain original triangle topology and all frame/back/mullion geometry, keep every node identity and shift declared convex contours to the identical final Float32 coordinates. Supports: grounded closed .24 x .06 x .38 base, closed .08 x .52 x .04 post, actual positive-volume contact into convex thick backing, plus distinct solid low support feet. Production: editable parameters, exact source/contract/generator/model SHA256 pins, deterministic CPU GLTFExporter and actual GLTFLoader readback. No baked reflection image, new light, new clock, moving support or physics simulation. Actual host-scene reflection continues through the existing shared runtime. Support design: The original .68m by 1.68m full-length rectangular mirror on left/right long feet joined by a real crossbar.
provenance.method: CPU GLTFLoader imports the complete pinned wall-mirror GLB, bakes +.92m Y into every mesh vertex, preserves topology and material, and adds solid baked BoxGeometry core and support parts. Float32 contour coordinates match actual exported vertices.
